title: Quaint Canadian Goats Cheese Tart
description: A festive Canadian dish featuring goats cheese in a flaky crust, perfect for the holiday season, this recipe is also macrobiotic-friendly and showcases a delightful balance of nutty and creamy flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice water to the flour mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out into a circle that is about 1/8 inch thick.
Transfer the dough to a 9 inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a small bowl, mix together the goats cheese, egg, black pepper, and thyme.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the bottom of the tart crust.
Fold the edges of the crust up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the crust with a little bit of water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
